t: 塞缪尔·沃里斯(Samuel Wallis)是一位英国出海船长,他看到塔希提岛,被认为是第一个…
te: Samuel Wallis, a British sea captain, sights Tahiti and is considered the first European to reach the island.
dz: 塞缪尔·沃里斯(Samuel Wallis)是一位英国出海船长,他看到塔希提岛,被认为是第一个到达该岛的欧洲人.
de: Samuel Wallis, a British sea captain, sights Tahiti and is considered the first European to reach the island.

t: 皮特凯恩岛由罗伯特·皮特凯恩船长在菲利普·卡特特指挥的远征航行中发现.
te: Pitcairn Island is discovered by Midshipman Robert Pitcairn on an expeditionary voyage commanded by Philip Carteret.
dz: 皮特凯恩岛由罗伯特·皮特凯恩船长在菲利普·卡特特指挥的远征航行中发现.
de: Pitcairn Island is discovered by Midshipman Robert Pitcairn on an expeditionary voyage commanded by Philip Carteret.

t: 挪威仍在印刷的最古老的报纸 Adresseavisen 成立并出版了第一版。
te: Norway's oldest newspaper still in print, Adresseavisen, is founded and the first edition is published.
dz: 挪威仍在印刷的最古老的报纸 Adresseavisen 成立并出版了第一版。
de: Norway's oldest newspaper still in print, Adresseavisen, is founded and the first edition is published.

t: 智利各地的耶稣会士因西班牙帝国镇压耶稣会而被捕。
te: Jesuits all over Chile are arrested as the Spanish Empire suppresses the Society of Jesus.
dz: 智利各地的耶稣会士因西班牙帝国镇压耶稣会而被捕。
